text.title: FreshDrop express slots, Moscow, 1–10 September 2026
text.hypothesis: we believe busy families will want fixed express slots; the sign-up rate at 10% will confirm it, because our surveys show slot misses
text.page: headline «Fixed slot, no missed courier», price 149 rub, button «Choose a slot»
text.traffic: Moscow families, targeted ads in messenger; 4,200 people saw it
text.action: leave an email to get the early access link
text.threshold: strong at 5% or more leave an email; we need 4,000 visitors
text.result: 4,200 views, 610 clicks, 48 plans; buyers said the price is clear
text.decision: build the early access flow in the app; change the price block for the second test
